idea-plugin.name: CompareMaster
idea-plugin.description:
Tool window with 2 editors for fast text comparison and transformation.
Supports JSON and XML workflows (format, sort, replace values, add missing values, escape/unescape, diff).
Also includes an "Any" mode for generic text formats with syntax highlighting and quick file-type selection.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What’s New

  • Fixed XML formatter compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 by removing the Groovy-based XML parser/serializer dependency.
  • XML now supports value replacement and adding missing values (same workflow as JSON).
  • New Any mode for general text files and quick syntax highlighting.
  • Type selection in Any mode is now faster: start typing and choose from autocomplete suggestions.
  • Any mode now supports formatting.
  • Improved type picker UX: compact one-line input, auto-focus, and remembered last selection during the session.
